Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable 2D woodland game artwork kit for Allrpcs. Match the approved Direction A painterly storybook gouache: matte visible brush marks, simplified generous forms, selective warm-dark edges, moss #536F3C and leaf #7F9B4E greens, weathered brown #6E4B2F, muted warm gray stone, restrained ochre late-afternoon highlights. Orthographic high-oblique three-quarter view, no horizon, negligible perspective convergence, consistent light from upper left. Actual transparent background. Each module fully visible with generous empty gutters, no overlaps, no cropped edges, no ground rectangles, no scene background, no UI, no labels or text, no sparkles, no photorealism. Own only a restrained local contact shadow, no long cast shadows. Arrange in a clean equal-cell grid across a landscape sheet; each cell contains one independent isolated module, clear separated silhouette, highest available resolution. This is one coordinated family sheet, not a scene.
Subject: Six trees in a 3-column 2-row sheet: top row a mature broad oak with asymmetrical rounded crown and readable branching trunk; a slender birch with pale warm bark and airy crown; a tall irregular woodland beech with narrower upright crown. Bottom row a smaller young oak with forked trunk; a bent weathered deciduous tree with sparse foliage and one bare limb; a slim sapling with modest leaf clusters. Keep mature trees tall with the whole crown and trunk/root contact visible. Cohesive temperate woodland, varied crown shapes, avoid identical round broccoli canopies.
